label: B3

parameters.task: synthetic binary classification proxy for stock-index direction

notes: B3 pilot uses a Havlicek ZZFeatureMap (Qiskit) with 3 qubits and reps=2 to match the paper's reported circuit scale. The classical baseline is an RBF-kernel SVM on the same synthetic task. Exact stock data is not reproduced because the paper did not publish the feature vector.
